what: qu-check6 (34f763ee6d), 16 errors, none in the macros. (1) hir/src/evict.rs:39-66, 15x E0599 no evict_values: per the contract (query-unify.md:475) evict_values*/set_lru_capacity exist only on functions with `lru = N` (0 too), since only their values are hashed so eviction keeps early cutoff. The 15 queries evict.rs drops (promoted_mir_body, runtime_promoted, optimized_mir_body*, monomorphized_mir_body*, monomorphized_promoted, monomorphized_optimized*) have no lru; mir_body_query has lru = 0 and compiles. Fix: add `lru = 0` to each (their values then need Hash), in hir-ty providers.rs and hir-ty-mir mir/lower.rs. (2) blaze-items index.rs:291 size_of::<AnyImpl>() == 12: blaze_query Id is NonZeroU32 (4 bytes) vs salsa 8 (index+generation), so the two-variant enum is now 8; change the assert to 8.

history.note: (1) hir evict.rs: per contract evict_values/set_lru_capacity exist only with `lru` (an evicted value is cut off by its hash, else it counts as changed); the fork gave every Hash-output query one. Fix is `lru = 0` on the 15 MIR queries: query-unify-port-hirty did the 3 in hir-ty-mir and is doing the 12 in hir-ty providers.rs. (2) blaze-items index.rs:291 size 8 fixed by query-unify-port-blaze.
